layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of expansive semi-arid plains
features: Flat, sun-baked earth with fine polygon crack patterns
Scattered thickets of scrubby Bennettitales and low-lying Cycads
Ground cover of dry, golden-brown moss and hardy liverworts
Brilliant, washed-out blue sky with high-noon clarity
Heat shimmer visible on the distant, flat horizon
No grass; ground is a mosaic of crusts and prehistoric scrub
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic, wide-angle view of an open, dry plain at noon. The ground is a patchwork of earthy reds and browns, accented by hardy green scrub. The lighting is intense and bright.

visuals.ground: Sun-baked silt and clay with a thin biological crust of dry mosses and liverworts. Clumps of leathery-leaved cycads grow in depressions. Absolutely no grass blades.
visuals.sky: Bright, pale blue sky; the sun is a brilliant white disk directly overhead, creating short, sharp shadows.
visuals.atmosphere: Dry and crystal clear; vibrant colors with a slight heat shimmer in the distance.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Crisp, flaky mud crusts and granular, parched soil. No grass.
